fields.name: Functions
fields.description: The functions available for the player

functions.name: Logout
functions.description:
Logs out the player.
This will save and unload the players character, as well as
mark the player as no longer known, meaning trying to receive
the player after a call to this function will probably result
in errors.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: the HPlayer object of the player to log out (see HELIX documentation for more info)

functions.name: Login
functions.description:
Logs in the player.
This will load the players character from the database,
create a player object, and call the 'QBCore:Server:OnPlayerLoaded' and
'QBCore:Client:OnPlayerLoaded' events.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: the HPlayer object of the player to log in (see HELIX documentation for more info)

parameters.name: citizenid
parameters.description: the citizen ID of the character to load. If nil a new character will be created with the provided newData.

parameters.name: newData
parameters.description: the data for the new character to create. This will be ignored if the citizenid parameter is provided.

returns.name: success
returns.description: true if the player was successfully logged in, false otherwise

functions.name: GetPlayerByLicense
functions.description:
Gets a player object by their license identifier.
This requires the player to be logged in.

parameters.name: license
parameters.description: the license identifier of the player

returns.name: player
returns.description: the player object if found, nil otherwise

functions.name: CheckPlayerData
functions.description:
Ensures that the provided player data has all required fields,
and creates a new player object. This should not be called if the
player is already logged in.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: the HPlayer object of the player to create (see HELIX documentation for more info)

parameters.name: PlayerData
parameters.description: the player data to check and create the player object with

functions.name: CreatePlayer
functions.description: Creates a new player object for the given player data.

parameters.name: PlayerData
parameters.description: the player data to create the player object with

parameters.name: Offline
parameters.description: whether the player is offline (true) or online (false)

functions.name: Save
functions.description: Saves the player to the database.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: the HPlayer object of the player to save (see HELIX documentation for more info)

functions.name: DeleteCharacter
functions.description:
Attempts to delete the character with the given citizenid for the player
with the given source.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: the HPlayer object to delete the character for

parameters.name: citizenid
parameters.description: the citizenid of the chracter to delete

returns.name: success
returns.description: true if the character was successfully deleted, false otherwise

functions.name: UpdatePlayerData
functions.description:
Updates the player data on the client.
This will trigger the 'QBCore:Player:SetPlayerData' event on the client with the players
current player data.
If the player is offline this function will do nothing.

functions.name: SetJob
functions.description:
Sets the job of the player.
This will update the players job data and trigger the 'QBCore:Client:OnJobUpdate' event on the client.
If the player is offline this will still update the job data, but will not trigger any client events.

parameters.name: job
parameters.description: the name of the job to set

parameters.name: grade
parameters.description: the grade level of the job to set

returns.name: success
returns.description: true if the job was successfully set, false otherwise

functions.name: SetGang
functions.description:
Sets the gang of the player.
This will update the players gang data and trigger the 'QBCore:Client:OnGangUpdate' event on the client.
If the player is offline this will still update the gang data, but will not trigger any client events.

parameters.name: gang
parameters.description: the name of the gang to set

parameters.name: grade
parameters.description: the grade level of the gang to set

returns.name: success
returns.description: true if the gang was successfully set, false otherwise

functions.name: Notify
functions.description:
Sends a notification to the player.
This will trigger the 'QBCore:Notify' event on the client with the provided parameters.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: the text of the notification

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: the type of the notification (default: 'primary')

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: the length of time the notification should be displayed

parameters.name: icon
parameters.description: the icon to display with the notification

functions.name: HasItem
functions.description:
Checks if the player has the given item(s).
This will check if the player has the given item or list of items.

parameters.name: items
parameters.description:
not sure about the table format.
the code of that is a little hard to read.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: the amount of the item(s) to check for (default: 1)

returns.name: hasItem
returns.description: true if the player has the item(s), false otherwise

functions.name: SetJobDuty
functions.description:
Sets the job duty status of the player.
This will update the players job duty status and trigger the 'QBCore:Client:OnJobUpdate' event on the client.

parameters.name: onDuty
parameters.description: whether the player is on duty for their job

functions.name: SetPlayerData
functions.description:
Sets a key in the player's data to the given value.
This will update the player's data and trigger the 'QBCore:Player:SetPlayerData' event on the client.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: the key in the player's data to set

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: the value to set the key to

functions.name: SetMetaData
functions.description:
Sets a metadata key in the player's metadata to the given value.
This will update the player's metadata and trigger the 'QBCore:Player:SetPlayerData' event on the client.

parameters.name: meta
parameters.description: the metadata key to set

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: the value to set the metadata key to

functions.name: GetMetaData
functions.description:
Gets a metadata value from the player's metadata.
This will return the value of the given metadata key.

parameters.name: meta
parameters.description: the metadata key to get

returns.name: value
returns.description: the value of the metadata key

functions.name: AddJobReputation
functions.description:
Adds job reputation to the player for their current job.
This will update the player's job reputation in their metadata
and trigger the 'QBCore:Player:SetPlayerData' event on the client.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: the amount of job reputation to add

functions.name: AddMoney
functions.description:
Adds money to the player's account.
This will update the player's money and trigger the 'QBCore:Client:OnMoneyChange'
as well as 'qb-hud:client:OnMoneyChange' events on the client.
A negative amount will be ignored and the function will return false.

parameters.name: moneytype
parameters.description: the type of money to add (e.g. 'cash', 'bank', etc.)

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: the amount of money to add

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: the reason for adding the money (default: 'unknown')

returns.name: success
returns.description: true if the money was successfully added, false otherwise

functions.name: RemoveMoney
functions.description:
Removes money from the player's account.
This will update the player's money and trigger the 'QBCore:Client:OnMoneyChange'
as well as 'qb-hud:client:OnMoneyChange' events on the client.
If the account is 'bank' it will also trigger the 'qb-phone:client:RemoveBankMoney' event.
A negative amount will be ignored and the function will return false.

parameters.name: moneytype
parameters.description: the type of money to remove (e.g. 'cash', 'bank', etc.)

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: the amount of money to remove

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: the reason for removing the money (default: 'unknown')

returns.name: success
returns.description: true if the money was successfully removed, false otherwise

functions.name: SetMoney
functions.description:
Sets the player's money to the given amount.
This will update the player's money and trigger the 'QBCore:Client:OnMoneyChange'
as well as 'qb-hud:client:OnMoneyChange' events on the client.
A negative amount will be ignored and the function will return false.

parameters.name: moneytype
parameters.description: the type of money to set (e.g. 'cash', 'bank', etc.)

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: the amount of money to set

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: the reason for setting the money (default: 'unknown')

returns.name: success
returns.description: true if the money was successfully set, false otherwise

functions.name: GetMoney
functions.description: Gets the amount of money the player has for the given money type.

parameters.name: moneytype
parameters.description: the type of money to get (e.g. 'cash', 'bank', etc.)

returns.name: amount
returns.description: the amount of money the player has, or nil if the money type is invalid

functions.name: SetCreditCard
functions.description:
Sets the player's credit/debit card number.
This will update the player's character info and trigger the 'QBCore:Player:SetPlayerData' event on the client.

parameters.name: cardNumber
parameters.description: the credit/debit card number to set

functions.name: GetCardSlot
functions.description:
Gets the inventory slot of the player's card with the given card number and type.
This will search the player's inventory for the card and return the slot if found.
If not found, it will return nil.

parameters.name: cardNumber
parameters.description: the credit/debit card number to search for

parameters.name: cardType
parameters.description: the type of card to search for (e.g. 'credit', 'debit', etc.)

returns.name: slot
returns.description: the inventory slot of the card if found, or nil if not found

functions.name: Save
functions.description:
Saves the player to the database.
If the player is offline, this will save the offline player data.
If the player is online, this will save the online player data.

functions.name: Logout
functions.description:
Logs out the player.
This will save and unload the players character, as well as
mark the player as no longer known, meaning trying to receive
the player after a call to this function will probably result
in errors.

functions.name: AddMethod
functions.description:
Adds a new method to the player object.
This will add the given method to the player's Functions table.
This will only affect the current player object and not all player objects.

parameters.name: methodName
parameters.description: the name of the method to add

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: the function to add as the method

functions.name: AddField
functions.description:
Adds a new field to the player object.
This will add the given field to the player object.
This will only affect the current player object and not all player objects.

parameters.name: fieldName
parameters.description: the name of the field to add

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: the data to set the field to
